title: Add explicit process cleanup on Terminal drop
description:
Currently Terminal relies on implicit OS cleanup (SIGHUP on PTY close) rather than explicit process termination.

Issues:
1. Child process handle (_child) is dropped immediately after spawn, not stored
2. No Drop implementation for Terminal
3. Reader thread is not joined, just abandoned
4. Processes ignoring SIGHUP could remain running

Fix:
- Store child process handle in Terminal struct
- Implement Drop for Terminal to:
  - Kill child process explicitly
  - Wait for child to exit
  - Join reader thread
- Consider graceful shutdown (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after timeout)
close_reason: Implemented explicit cleanup: stored child handle, added Drop impl to kill child, wait for exit, and join reader thread

title: Integrate with Claude hooks to show tab attention state

Extract logic into pure functions, separate concerns (UI rendering vs business logic), add dependency injection where needed for mocking PTY/terminal. Current structure has tightly coupled App/Tab/Terminal structs that are hard to test in isolation.

close_reason: 46 unit tests added across all modules: app (22 tests for state/commands), input (9 tests for key conversion), pty (3 tests for mock), terminal (6 tests with MockPty), ui (6 tests for styling). title: Kill all Claude and terminal instances on quit (pressing q)
description:
When the user presses 'q' to quit the application, ensure proper cleanup of all spawned processes:

1. Kill all terminal PTY child processes (shells spawned in left/right panes)
2. Kill all Claude CLI instances (running in right pane)
3. Wait for processes to terminate gracefully before force-killing
4. Clean up any zombie processes

Currently the application may leave orphaned processes running after quit.
close_reason: Already implemented - processes are properly cleaned up on quit

title: Define worktree folder structure and path resolution
description: Establish the folder structure convention for worktrees. Commands run from <main> worktree. New worktrees are created as siblings: <project>.<branch>. Path template: ../<repo-name>.<branch-name>. Example: running from /code/myapp creates worktree at /code/myapp.feature-x for branch 'feature-x'. All commands should use this resolution logic.

title: Implement 'remove' command for worktree manager
description: Add a 'remove' subcommand that deletes a git worktree. Before removing, check: (1) if branch is merged to main - warn if not merged, (2) if there are uncommitted changes - warn if so. Require confirmation or force flag to proceed with warnings.

title: Escape key conflicts with vim/helix normal mode

This makes modal editors unusable. Options: (1) pass all keys in insert mode, (2) use different key for TUI normal mode, (3) add passthrough mode.
